title: Change Warm-up Time
symptom: Using the G6+ transmitter/sensors (Transmitter SN 22xxxx) & xDrip (nightly 16/01/2020), the G6+ only requires a 1 hour warmup as per documentation and xDrip starts receiving data before the standard 2 hour warmup time. The user asks if there is a way to reduce the warm-up time to match the transmitter/sensor. Additionally, they have had wildly out readings and a sensor failure at 10d, and after inserting a new sensor readings are still way out after 5+ hours (more than 2mmol/L).
evidence_quote: I did not get a solution for this, however we are not using the G6+ anymore and the warm up is no longer an issue.
